description: React component for managing user roles via a modal dialog in the Mattermost admin console, including role assignment, permissions, and user info display.

classes.name: ManageRolesModal
classes.description: React component class for managing user roles within a modal dialog, handling role updates, user info display, and permission toggles.

methods.name: getStateFromProps
methods.description: Initializes component state based on user roles from props.

methods.name: handleError
methods.description: Sets error state when role update fails.

methods.name: handleSystemAdminChange
methods.description: Handles toggling between system admin and member roles.

methods.name: handleUserAccessTokenChange
methods.description: Handles toggling user access token permission.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Saves updated roles to the server and handles success or error.

methods.name: renderContents
methods.description: Renders modal content including user info, role options, and permissions.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the modal dialog with header, body, and footer buttons.
